boundary: Each command starts a separate native CLI process. Session A remains active after its caller exits and is explicitly resumed as Session B; this models loss of caller memory, not a power-loss or model-quality experiment. Runtime writes use AWR CLI only; SQLite is read-only evidence. Missing checkpoints must expose unavailable saved state. Source refresh during rejected preflight may update projections, but must not create a successor or alter existing session/claim/checkpoint records. All changes use new disposable copies.
counting: All four cases and all applicable gates must pass. Explicit absence of saved state is the expected missing-checkpoint outcome, never a claim that unrecorded memory was recovered. L0 uses an explicit 3000-token orientation budget here; the V1 1000-token metric remains a separate benchmark. No metrics, E4 scenarios or release are completed by this contract.
